errors.text: The proposed severe-plastic-deformation intervention does not reconstruct the intermediate-temperature aging intervention or the observed ductile-brittle-ductile transition.
Severe plastic deformation changes the alloy's as-designed microstructure and mechanical properties, so retention of the original strength-ductility combination is assumed rather than demonstrated.
The cited evidence concerns grain-refinement strengthening or L12 precipitation, not post-exposure toughness retention following severe plastic deformation.
The broad 473-1073 K range does not identify the critical 550-750°C embrittlement window or the distinct behavior near 600°C and 750°C.
The proposed mechanism omits L12 ordering, antiphase-boundary energy, restricted cross-slip, jagged B2/FCC phase boundaries, and ductile transition-zone formation.
